Question 3
?

Find f(x,y) such that ∇f(x,y)=F(x,y), where F(x,y)=yexy i+(xexy+2y) j.

a
f(x,y)=xexy+2+C
b
f(x,y)=yexy+x2+C
c
f(x,y)=exy+y2+C
d
f(x,y)=exy+xy+C
e
f(x,y)=xyexy+y+C
